tools.description: Search the first-edition title reference by title or author. Returns matching collectible titles with their per-title identification-page URLs. Use nmlp_identify_first_edition for the full points of one specific title.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: nmlp_check_coverage, nmlp_search_qa, nmlp_get_pillar_guides, nmlp_search_titles · Private data: nmlp_get_archive, nmlp_lccn_lookup, nmlp_vinyl_lookup, nmlp_resolve · Public sink: nmlp_check_coverage, nmlp_schedule_pickup · Destructive: nmlp_check_coverage, nmlp_schedule_pickup, nmlp_get_business_card.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: nmlp_check_coverage, nmlp_search_qa, nmlp_get_pillar_guides, nmlp_search_titles · Private data: nmlp_get_archive, nmlp_lccn_lookup, nmlp_vinyl_lookup, nmlp_resolve · Public sink: nmlp_check_coverage, nmlp_schedule_pickup · Destructive: nmlp_check_coverage, nmlp_schedule_pickup, nmlp_get_business_card

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
